title: 第608章 进城第608章 进城
slug: 修仙所有人都以为她背景很强
lines: 半个时辰后，巫未央拎着一条红宝石项链靠近路边正在交谈的一人一妖。
看见那只兔妖眼里闪过亮光时，巫未央就知道有希望了。
她咳嗽两声，还没开口，沐暮就已经神色认真道，“尊贵的兔妖大人，其实我们是跑商，这位是我的同伴，这条项链就是我们想要卖你的东西。”
尊贵的兔妖...大人？
巫未央没忍住侧目，印象中，沐暮总是冰冷沉默的，虽然交谈时会相对缓和一些，但这种谄媚的态度，对于一个少宗主来说，还是有些幻灭了。
她以为只有慕逸能说出这种话，但她想起那头大白虎，一切好像都有迹可寻。
巫未央摇摇头，加入沐暮的谄媚举动，“兔妖大人，您看，这条项链正好与你的耳饰相配，而且它能聚集妖气。”
这是妖族领域一种火焰晶，巫未央施展禁制后，它会不由自主吸引周围的火灵气。
兔妖穿着一身金色的衣裳，头颅上高高竖起的粉白双耳，点缀了两枚镶嵌了红宝石的金耳环。
它紧盯巫未央手上的红宝石项链，眼眸亮着，不过它显然见识不浅，“火焰晶吸引妖气的能力很弱吧，倒是样式确实和我的耳环相配。”
照着它耳环样式炼制的怎么会不相配呢。
外面半个时辰，巫未央就在流光阵里待了十个时辰，不少时间都贡献在了打磨样式上。
在妖族领域，能被巫未央轻易得到的火焰晶确实不是什么珍贵的宝贝，只能期待在兔妖是个看颜值且大方的妖。
沐暮接着兔妖的话，态度是十足的恭敬，“我们都是小妖，没有特别好的东西，看见兔妖大人的耳环后觉得相配，才斗胆让兔妖大人看一看这条项链。”
“兔妖大人，可以摸一摸。”巫未央将红宝石项链往前递了递，“火焰晶虽然本身吸引妖气的能力很弱，但是我制作的这条项链，能力会比很多火焰晶制作的契物都要好上一些。”
禁制术不论在哪里，都是罕见的存在。
“好吧，我要了。”兔妖听着两人一口一个兔妖大人，有些飘飘然地接过项链。
兔妖在中心大陆不算什么强盛的妖族，没有人会这样称呼它们，这两只小妖一看就是外边来的，看在它们可怜又识相的份上，兔妖决定满足它们的愿望。
“咦，你的项链能力确实不错。”兔妖摸了摸项链中央的火焰晶，“算是下阶上品契物，我给你们两千石晶好了。”
不论这个价格是高是低，巫未央两人都感恩戴德地谢过了它。
兔妖掏了掏耳朵，一堆石晶掉在了地上。
妖族石晶不像灵石那样分出上中下品，因为妖气包含了灵气和杂气，就算晶石里包含杂气，对它们来说也是浓度一样的。
但妖族没有储物袋，不习惯将石晶放在一个袋子里，这点就很不方便。
巫未央和沐暮只能蹲下捡石晶。
刚刚还从容自若的沐暮，现在属实是有些不自在了。
他堂堂少宗主，何时要在地上捡过东西。
趁周围无妖时，两人才赶紧用灵力将石晶都摄走，然后将身上气息都收敛，随着妖流进入了高城。
断角城。
城池里相当热闹，高高大大石质建筑，上面刻着各种各样的图腾，其中最多的便是凤凰和火焰的纹路。
街道上浓烈杂乱的妖气充斥，沐暮感到了不适。
content_en:
Half an hour later, Wu Weiyang approached a man and a demon who were talking on the roadside, carrying a ruby ​​necklace.
When she saw the light flashing in the rabbit demon's eyes, Wu Weiyang knew there was hope.
She coughed twice, but before she could speak, Mu Mu said with a serious look, "Dear Lord Rabbit Demon, we are actually businessmen. This is my companion. This necklace is what we want to sell you."
The noble rabbit demon...my lord?
Wu Weiyang couldn't help but glance sideways. In the impression, Mu Mu was always cold and silent. Although he would be relatively relaxed when talking, this kind of flattering attitude was still a bit disillusioning for a young sect leader.
She thought that only Mu Yi could say such words, but when she thought of the big white tiger, everything seemed to be traceable.
Wu Weiyang shook her head and joined in Mu Mu's flattery, "Lord Rabbit Demon, look, this necklace just matches your earrings, and it can gather demon energy."
This is a kind of flame crystal in the demon realm. After Wu Weiyang casts the restriction, it will involuntarily attract the surrounding fire aura.
The rabbit demon was dressed in golden clothes, and the pink and white ears standing high on his head were decorated with two gold earrings inlaid with rubies.
It stared closely at the ruby necklace in Wu Weiyang's hand, its eyes bright, but it was obviously knowledgeable, "The flame crystal's ability to attract evil spirits is very weak, but the style does match my earrings."
How could the earrings made according to its style not match?
After half an hour outside, Wu Weiyang stayed in the streamer array for ten hours, spending a lot of time on polishing the style.
In the realm of the monster clan, the flame crystal that Wu Weiyang can easily obtain is indeed not a precious treasure. We can only hope that the rabbit monster will be a good-looking and generous monster.
Mu Mu followed the Rabbit Demon's words with a completely respectful attitude, "We are all little demons, and we don't have anything particularly good. After seeing Master Rabbit Demon's earrings, I thought they matched, so I dared to let Master Rabbit Demon take a look at this necklace."
"Master Rabbit Demon, you can touch it." Wu Weiyang handed the ruby necklace forward, "Although the flame crystal itself has a weak ability to attract demonic energy, the necklace I made will be better than many deeds made of flame crystals."
No matter where the restraint technique is, it is rare.
"Okay, I'll take it." The Rabbit Demon listened to the two of them speaking to each other, and Master Rabbit Demon took the necklace with some airiness.
The Rabbit Demon is not a powerful demon tribe in the Central Continent. No one would call them that. These two little demons looked like they were from outside. Seeing how pitiful and sensible they were, the Rabbit Demon decided to fulfill their wishes.
"Hey, your necklace ability is really good." The rabbit demon touched the flame crystal in the center of the necklace, "It is considered a lower-level high-grade deed. I will give you two thousand stone crystals."
Regardless of whether the price was high or low, both Wu Weiyang and Wu Weiyang thanked it gratefully.
The rabbit demon took out his ears, and a pile of stone crystals fell to the ground.
Monster crystals are not divided into high, middle and low grades like spiritual stones, because the demonic energy contains spiritual energy and miscellaneous energy. Even if the crystal contains miscellaneous energy, the concentration is the same for them.
However, the demon clan does not have a storage bag and is not used to putting stone crystals in a bag, which is very inconvenient.
Wu Weiyang and Mu Mu could only squat down and pick up the stone crystals.
Mu Mu, who was calm and composed just now, is really a little uncomfortable now.
When did he, the majestic young sect master, ever pick up something on the ground?
When there were no demons around, the two people quickly used their spiritual power to absorb all the stone crystals, then restrained their auras and followed the demon flow into Gaocheng.
Brokenhorn City.
The city is quite lively, with tall and large stone buildings carved with various totems, the most common of which are phoenix and flame patterns.
The streets were filled with strong and chaotic evil spirits, and Mu Mu felt uncomfortable.
